{{Quote|Her name's Vinna Jiss. And she's a government employee.''"<br />"''I'm not going to like this, am I''"<br />"''Not when you hear she works in GAR logistics, no.|Sev and Fi Skirata, on Vinna Jiss|<ref name="tz" />}}
'''Vinna Jiss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] logistics employee who worked under [[Besany Wennen]] and sided with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Vinna met with [[Paxaz Izhiq]], a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] criminal, and made a deal to exchange illegal goods in a warehouse-block between two freighters. However, she was captured by [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] [[Fi Skirata|Fi]] and [[Sev/Legends|Sev]], who interrogated her for information. After explaining everything to them, she was ultimately executed by [[Walon Vau]]. [[Jinart]] the [[Gurlanin]] later impersonated her form, not knowing that the real Vinna Jiss had been killed by Vau.<ref name="tz" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|"The other fortunate thing is that I was able to talk to Vinna Jiss's supervisor at GAR logistics as her&hellip;landlord and complain that she had skipped owing me rent. The supervisor was sympathetic and said she was an unreliable employee.|Walon Vau|<ref name="tz" />}}
Vinna Jiss was described by her supervisor as an undependable worker.<ref name="tz" />
